[Updates]{.eyebrow}

Announcements, milestones, meetings, and outputs from the collaboration.

### May 2026 — Workshop final report released

The final report of the AIM workshop *Addressing Declining Pollinator Populations Through New Mathematics* is complete, synthesising outcomes from all eight working groups and setting out a coordinated twelve-month research and partnership roadmap.

### April 2026 — Workshop concludes at AIM

The workshop ran March 30 – April 5, 2026, convening mathematicians, ecologists, data scientists, and commercial beekeeping practitioners. Eight working groups produced the six priority research directions that now define the collaboration's agenda.

### In progress — Phase I infrastructure

Work is underway on the shared dataset crosswalk, sub-team formation around the six priority areas, and a power analysis for a future large-scale monitoring study.
